title: closing-bible build plan (build-plan.json)
description: PRD §4 'Gate 2: Build-plan approval': the exact document order, the selected source file for each item, output names, conversion steps and any qualified statuses. Written by `plan` from an APPROVED closing-index; approved by the lawyer (approved: true); consumed by `build` and `update`, which refuse an unapproved plan or one whose corpus_id or index hash has moved. Nothing is assembled that is not on this plan.

index_sha256.description: sha256 of the approved closing-index.json bytes this plan was built from; build refuses if the index on disk differs.

approved.description: true only after the lawyer approved the plan at Gate 2. build/update refuse false.

include_qualified.description: PRD §9: qualified items (unsigned, undated, incomplete) enter the bible only on express instruction. false = only ready and not-required-excluded; true = qualified items included, each visibly qualified in the index and receipt, and the receipt outcome cannot be complete.

folder.description: closing-bible-vNNN, created beside the closing folder; never inside it.

prior_folder.description: For update: the prior package, preserved untouched.

output_name.description: NNN - Title.<ext> inside indexed-set/; the native file keeps its extension, the rendered copy is .pdf.

conversion.description: none: already a PDF. docx-to-pdf: converted for the combined PDF only, native retained. unrenderable: kept native in indexed-set, absent from the combined PDF, named in the receipt.

execution_pages.description: Signature-page numbers within the source, from execution-overview; bookmarked in the combined PDF.

excluded.description: Every index item NOT entering the bible, with the reason — the lawyer sees the whole set at Gate 2.

volume_pages.description: Split the combined PDF into numbered volumes of at most this many pages, with a master index; null = single file.
